title: Serializing a Model 📦
ques: Save a trained model `clf` to a file named `model.pkl` using the **`pickle`** module.

answer.content:
import pickle

with open('model.pkl', 'wb') as f:
    pickle.dump(clf, f)

explanation: **Serialization** (pickling) allows you to save your trained model to disk so it can be loaded later without retraining.
